preconditions: id is required. name/icon/color/sort_order edit; slug and is_default never change after creation.

description: Edits a category's name, icon, color, or sort_order — slug and is_default are the category's fixed identity, and any attempt to change either refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR. color, when given, must be a #rrggbb hex value. Create a new category instead of trying to rename an existing slug.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: expense_category_update
